name: Inayatiyya Switzerland (Sufi Zentrum Omega)
reason: Too little usable content: sufismus.ch (Sufi Zentrum Omega, Zawiya Sophia in Zürich and Khanqah Inayatiyya retreat house in Erschmatt, Valais) shows programme dates without titles or prices in readable form, hides the street addresses and most emails behind obfuscation, and has no channel; its offers are largely psychotherapy, dream work and a healing circle (health rule). Photos and a plain omega@sufismus.ch email exist, so it could be revisited by hand.
